CustomField.description: Days a finished import or bulk job (Import_Batch__c with its rows and journal) is kept once its undo window has closed, before the nightly Record Cleanup step deletes it (architect review L-08, R-NJ8). Read as 365 when empty, held between 30 and 3650.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days a finished import is kept, after it can no longer be undone, before it is deleted.
CustomField.label: Days to Keep Import History
